notes.title: Devlog #9
notes.notes:
Interior design and arrangement of medical equipment is one of the last stages of the hospital's renovation. The decor consists of decorating it in an appropriate style and the care and functionality of all rooms. The more you implement the guidelines, the more money you get.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/0a398877fa00327aa121fc69a008840234ed5a38.gif[/img]

The next step is placing the necessary medical equipment to make the room functional. Medical equipment will not be required in all rooms (e.g., waiting room). It would be best if you were prepared to buy completely new equipment, as the equipment in the old building's condition may be unusable. The renovation budget is limited!

Upon completion of this stage, the client accepts it. The amount of remuneration is influenced by the orders' quality and quantity.

Prepare enough cash for a renovation and be ready to go! We also invite you to join the Discord GamesUP Studio server!

[url=https://discord.gg/MXGzYFPYTs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/54e837ec6a49821f2f5ed6524c11f4acde1f71ea.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #8
notes.notes:
Sometimes your patients may not survive the hospital visit, so think carefully about where to locate the morgue when renovating. This is important as transporting the deceased person should not take too long.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/93d731f84aa89546656760eeb3cbc697a6bac29c.gif[/img]

The body should not be kept in a hospital cold room for more than 72 hours. This time may be extended only in exceptional cases. Then the relative is responsible for the identification, after which the body of the deceased should be washed before being transferred to the dissecting room. Transport of the body may only take place by a reliable means of transportation. As renovators, do not forget about such an investment in this place. After the research is completed, the body is handed over to the funeral director, where your role ends.

Today's devlog was dark, but no hospital can function adequately without the facilities mentioned above. Welcome to Discord GamesUP Studio, where you can discuss game development with the developers!

notes.title: Devlog #7
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

Development is significant. Therefore, a very important aspect of a Hospital Renovator is the modernization of tools used in the renovation of the hospital. At any time, you can return to your sole proprietorship office and upgrade your tools with the money you earn. The better equipment significantly speeds up work, such as: demolishing walls, flying pipes, repairing cables, or removing stains. As you develop, you will be able to unlock additional tools and equipment to diversify your gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/97269b67f527175d1261d73f7d215f848b3777a3.png[/img]

What do you think, which equipment will be the most useful during the renovation? Share your feelings in the comments section with us, and don’t forget to check GamesUp Studio’s social media!

[url=https://discord.gg/MXGzYFPYTs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/54e837ec6a49821f2f5ed6524c11f4acde1f71ea.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.notes:
Welcome renovators!

The comfort of your patients should be one of the highest priorities. The waiting room must be arranged appropriately, have a simple design, clear and legible information, and comfortable chairs. During the renovation, you should have no problems with your work as waiting rooms are not complicated but are mandatory in every hospital.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/10aec6a25f7d52a8270a5cd412ffb95188ae5fa7.gif[/img]

It is also essential that patients have no problem leaving the room, in addition, remember about the number of chairs (to increase the comfort of use, this will, of course, translate into better ratings for your hospital). Many lovely plants to diversify the look, a few rubbish bins, and voila, we have a ready waiting room that meets all standards.

Of course, this is not the maximum of possibilities, each of you will arrange your facilities at your discretion! We also encourage you to visit other social media!

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.notes:
Hi! 

Today I will tell you more about the operation room. 

OR should be spacious and easy to clean. There should be a unique air filter to make this place sterile and with the right temperature and humidity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/1dc9f0cf7a71926544ff8dd6b77257ac30988ea4.png[/img]

The heart of this room will be an operating table. It should be stable and have been well-lighted without it. The surgeon won’t see clearly and can miss something important. 

Prepare a table with needed tools and medical equipment like an anesthesia cart, defibrillator, monitors, blood pressure measuring machine, and maybe a surgeon mechanic arm. 

Don’t forget about a place where doctors, nurses, and assistants can clean their hands and wear unique clothes. 

That’s all for today. See you next time!

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

At the request of one of the users in today’s devlog, we will describe the Orthopedy ward! Orthopedics is one of the primary medical specialties and focuses on diagnosing and treating diseases related to bones and the musculoskeletal system. The difficulty in planning the renovation of the ward consists mainly of arranging an appropriate space at the disposal of each patient and providing them with the greatest possible comfort.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/a4477c7c7c04e5878d9c94a9755779b5ed912ea8.png[/img]

Every person will be satisfied thanks to a comfortable bed, modern equipment, and optimal rehabilitation conditions. The operating room is the most essential and hardware-demanding place. A big problem is a progressive wear diagnostic and technical gear, arthroscopic devices, tool kits, or other equipment. For this reason, a significant part of the funds has to be allocated to the current resources replenishment. Each orthopedic ward should have: a dressing warehouse, recovery room, dressing room, plaster room, and cleaning rooms. 

Orthopedic beds will be very important. It is equipment specially designed for the needs of patients. If you are rich enough, you will have the option of purchasing modern devices, like video otoscope or x-ray monitoring. It all depends on the effort you put into your work.

Prepare properly and take care of your patients. If you are interested in these topics, visit our Discord and other social media!

[url=https://discord.gg/fY4wWDR29v][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/54e837ec6a49821f2f5ed6524c11f4acde1f71ea.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Last time I told you about the ER, which you usually see when going to the hospital. Today I will tell you about the maternity unit.

The delivery suite is quite a unique room in my opinion because it has to be prepared for everything. One of the essential things here will be the birthing chair. But it shouldn't be the only thing here. Give a choice to women how she wants to give birth. Prepare a mattress, ball, even a bath tube! Don't forget about the father who can participate in it. Add some chair or sofa for him. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/8c7bd44a9fded226da4ccae69220ab026aa834c5.png[/img]

You will need a lot of medical equipment like, for example, anesthesia or an incubator. You will never know if it will be required or not. 

Sometimes a C-section so prepare an operation room (soon, I will talk more about it).

Maternity unity also needs a room for the mother and her baby. It should be comfortable, have a toilet, a changing table, and a second parent's place. 

Close to that ward is the neonatologist ward, which is for newborn babies. There should be incubators, beds for infants, and Bili lights. 

Thank you for today. In the next devlogs, we will talk about other wards. And also, we invite you to visit our social media!

[url=https://discord.gg/MfzDVGZZzp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/54e837ec6a49821f2f5ed6524c11f4acde1f71ea.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
Hello. 

Today I will tell you about the first places which you usually visit when you go to the hospital. 

If something bad happens to you, you will probably be brought to the hospital by ambulance. So as a renovator you have to take care of the driveway and garage for ambo. It has to be spacious and close to the ER. 

Sometimes there is a need for something faster than an ambulance, so create a place for a medical helicopter. It will probably be on the top of the building. The best idea would be to make it straight over the ER, connected to it with an elevator. Don’t forget about emergency stairs! We don’t want to trap your paramedic with a seriously ill person on the roof. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/f8d802c6206e65aa471c7b0011124a300d8d0b22.png[/img]

Ok. So you are in the ER. What should be here? What should it look like? So the first thing is to create a room for your patients. It will be best if you hang some curtains between beds. It will give a little bit of privacy to patients. They will be grateful for that, especially if they did something embarrassing. Don’t forget about medical equipment which may be useful in case of danger to someone's life. 

Add a reception in the corridor. There will be a first-place that will tell the family of the patient about where he/she is. Prepare also some comfortable chairs. Sometimes people wait a long time before they hear what happened. That can frustrate them so add some coffee tables with magazines or hang a TV to kill the time. 

That’s all for today. Which ward do you want me to do next? Tell us in the comments. 

[url=https://discord.gg/fY4wWDR29v][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/54e837ec6a49821f2f5ed6524c11f4acde1f71ea.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Have you ever wondered what would it be like to run your hospital? What to do, where to start? How and where can I buy the required equipment? You will find answers to these and other questions in our production- Hospital Renovator!

The player takes on the role of a hospital conservator. Your task is to renovate the hospital complex to restore its functionality. Each room must be brought to such a state that patients feel comfortable in it and that all safety standards are met. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/8df6a00ca3192afbc50884be02ba06436a762c84.gif[/img]

After a successful renovation, it will be a time to decorate the renovated room and also arrange medical equipment. As you know, every hospital is divided into departments. You will need to organize an intensive care unit or an ENT unit accordingly. Think about every move, it’s up to you to make this hospital functional enough to help people. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41039272/58ba7cfa2607b8d3ab7ea36374cf2f9ce027afe9.gif[/img]

Thank you very much for your attention. We hope, that you are excited. We will keep you informed in the next devlogs. And don’t forget to check our social media!
